zh-CN.Research notes on offline app privacy wo: 围绕“Offline App Privacy Workflow Research: Local Capture, Review, And Export”的私密会议转写流程，帮助用户在设备端处理会议、采访、课堂和语音备忘录，并复盘说话人与行动项。
zh-CN.What does privacy-first design mean in a: 会议、采访、课堂和语音备忘录可能包含客户信息、内部计划或个人内容。Priviscribe / Private Meeting Transcriber 的核心价值是设备端私密转写。
zh-CN.Privacy is a workflow property. The safe: 把手机放在能清楚收音的位置，每次会议或采访单独录制。清晰、分段的音频更容易复盘，也更容易管理。
zh-CN.Sensitive records often reveal more than: 转写后检查并重命名说话人。知道是谁提出问题、承诺事项或做出决定，会议笔记才真正可用。
zh-CN.Map the data lifecycle: capture, tempora: 分享前先判断对方需要摘要、动作项还是完整转写。私密工作流的重点是由用户决定哪些内容离开设备。
zh-CN.Offline-first is not the same as impossi: Offline-first is not the same as impossible to share. Users still need PDF export, text export, printing, AirDrop, email, and backups. The privacy question is who initiates the transfer and whether the app uploads by default. The interpretation step matters because many optimization tools can make a bad result look precise. Precision is not the same as truth. A realistic research workflow asks what was not measured, which assumptions could change, and whether a slightly less efficient result might be safer, more private, easier to review, or more likely to be finished.
zh-CN.Design app pages and workflows around us: Design app pages and workflows around user-controlled output: capture locally, review clearly, then export only the final artifact. The practical workflow is capture, review, compare, save, and export only when the result is ready. For physical projects, that means no cutting before the plan is checked. For app workflows, it means no sharing before the record is reviewed. For research-style SEO content, it means every claim should point back to a repeatable action, a measurable metric, or a clear user decision.
